$comment: VcpkgCaching_2 (RTM Build_01, Build_05): every library Iris-Slide builds against, first-party and third-party, prebuilt from vcpkg's binary cache; nothing is fetched at configure. The core is what every build needs, the JavaScript module's included: Iris-Headers and Iris-File-Extension. The baseline is vcpkg's release 2026.10.16 (scripts/bootstrap_vcpkg.cmake checks vcpkg out at it). Each direct third-party dependency's version is stated by an override, equal to Iris-Headers' cmake/dependencies.cmake where vcpkg has that version; Iris-Headers and Iris-File-Extension are pinned by commit in their overlay ports (ports/). development/PIPELINE.md lists each pin, its source and every difference.
name: iris-slide

library.description: The Iris-Slide library, the decoder (CMakeLists.txt): the image codecs, Highway, and the Vulkan, VMA and GLM headers Iris-Headers' private headers include

encoder.description: IrisSlideEncoder and the Python encoder module (IRIS_BUILD_ENCODER=ON): libdicom, and OpenJPEG for JPEG 2000 and HTJ2K source frames

openslide.description: Encoding from vendor slide files (IRIS_USE_OPENSLIDE=ON): OpenSlide's prebuilt shared library (ports/openslide-bin)

python.description: The Python modules (IRIS_BUILD_PYTHON=ON): pybind11, its headers and CMake files only (ports/pybind11)
